keywords: The Petitioners challenge the compensation determined in terms of the first Section 7 notice issued in 1987, whereas there is a subsequent Section 7 notice issued in 2016 in respect of the same acquired land in suit. Held – Acquiring Officer ought to have decided the amount of compensation based on the value of the land as at the issuance of the subsequent Section 7 notice. Writs issued.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
